description: Use this for how much someone can borrow for a mortgage and the price that reaches: from household income, deposit and monthly commitments, at the income multiples most lenders use and the higher multiple some offer, with the monthly repayment and a stress test. Give a price to check whether it is within reach.

flat.description: The home is a flat; some lenders lend less on flats.

household_income.description: Gross income a year, all buyers together.

monthly_commitments.description: Loans, cards and other monthly debts.

price.description: A price to check, such as a home’s asking price.

name: affordability_calculator
title: How much can I borrow
